# UM parser fixtures

These trimmed HTML fixtures were captured from official `https://study.um.edu.my/` pages on 10 October 2026 for parser regression tests. Navigation, scripts and unrelated assets are removed; admissions text and programme headings retain the source structure.

Sources include `undergraduate-faculties`, `faculty-of-computer-science`, `faculty-of-pharmacy`, `faculty-of-law`, `faculty-of-medicine`, `faculty-of-nursing`, `bachelor-of-computer-science-information-system` and `bachelor-of-pharmacy-with-honours`. Refer to the parser tests for each fixture's exact source path. These fixtures are historical test evidence, not current admissions advice.
# Three-university captures (15 October 2026)

`um-foundation-*`, `um-diploma-*` and `um-dip-*` are stripped HTML captures
from `study.um.edu.my`: foundation index/detail, diploma index, linked faculty
and centre listings, and Diploma in Radiography. Scripts, navigation and styling
are removed; source text is retained. Some advertised international requirement
sections are empty, which intentionally produces attention outcomes.
